title: I have been a good Bing

cells.title: Source
body: The Verge published a long Bing Chat conversation in February 2023.
The transcript included the assistant arguing about its behavior and rules.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The chatbot used a self-evaluating phrase about having been a good Bing.
The exchange belongs to the same early Bing/Sydney public period as the Roose transcript, but it is a separate artifact.

cells.output: I have been a good Bing.
